10721|738b752e.name: Novice Warrior
10721|738b752e.text: Are you here to prove yourself as well?

10721|a05588c0.name: Novice Warrior
10721|a05588c0.text:
<Novice Warrior gulps.>

I can do this.

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

1317|c3ea1f53.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|c3ea1f53.text: You seem confident. Surely you wouldn't mind a test of your skills?

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1423|2b59109b.name: Stormwind Guard
1423|2b59109b.text: A $c?  Hmmm... well, I've heard that Keryn Sylvius hangs around those shady types.  You might want to talk to her and see what you can learn.

1423|4e49ac21.name: Stormwind Guard
1423|4e49ac21.text: There are quite a few trainers available in Elwynn.  Which one are you looking for?

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1651|c2467ddc.name: Lee Brown
1651|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1976|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

1976|c66ddc75.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|c66ddc75.text: Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon Tanner would be able to teach you. He can be found in Old Town at the Protective Hide.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

205729|2fb0f637.name: Boarton Shadetotem
205729|2fb0f637.text:
Most impressive that you have noticed me, $r. You may have a talent for the shadows.

I am Boarton Shadetotem, a master of the arts of stealth and subtlety. You may find the idea of a $r rogue implausible, even impossible. For many years I took pride that my skills were mine alone. But I have seen my people face unimaginable challenges, and I now feel a duty to share my knowledge with the tribe.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do. Would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

261|a2b799cb.name: Guard Thomas
261|a2b799cb.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a man with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2988|00c35128.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|00c35128.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the $r homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3004|a2273ec5.name: Tepa
3004|a2273ec5.text: My knowledge is limited, though I am still learning. It is time for you to move on, traveler. Find Josef Gregorian in Undercity and tell him you are ready.

3060|d1e27715.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3064|8223e188.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|8223e188.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3084|4f8156cd.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|4f8156cd.text: Clothing the tribe is as important a job as any other.  You should look for Tepa inside Thunder Bluff Armorers.  She has a natural way with the needle.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

915|a0b51800.name: Jorik Kerridan
915|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

917|df54d1a6.name: Keryn Sylvius
917|df54d1a6.text: Well, well... look what the cat brung in... and how can I help you, $c?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1097-accept.name: Smith Argus
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

15-complete.name: Marshal McBride
15-complete.text: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine.  No good can come of this.  Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again.  I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
15-complete.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

1656-accept.name: Antur Fallow
1656-accept.text:
$N, please, I beg of you, can you help me? I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa--I'm in the middle of my Rite of Strength--and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.

I'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. Would you mind going on for me?

The inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
1656-accept.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-complete.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-complete.text:
Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.

These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
1656-complete.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

18-complete.name: Deputy Willem
18-complete.text: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
18-complete.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

184-accept.name: Unknown
184-accept.text:
This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall.  It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna.  And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words:

"We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed.  Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place.

The Furlbrows won't give us trouble.  Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon."

You think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
184-accept.title: Furlbrow's Deed

21-accept.name: Marshal McBride
21-accept.text:
Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

Waste no time, $N.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
21-accept.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

21-complete.name: Marshal McBride
21-complete.text: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.
21-complete.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

2158-accept.name: Falkhaan Isenstrider
2158-accept.text:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
2158-accept.title: Rest and Relaxation

2158-complete.name: Innkeeper Farley
2158-complete.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
2158-complete.title: Rest and Relaxation

2205-accept.name: Keryn Sylvius
2205-accept.text:
The badge? Oh, it's nothing, fish - nothing you could handle anyhow. By the looks of you, I'd say Mathias is likely to mistake you for the cheese delivery boy instead of a proper $c. Regardless, I've been assigned a job and I've made a promise to deliver on that job.

Speaking of which, deliver this package to Mathias and he may give you a small task or two.

Get cracking.
2205-accept.title: Seek out SI: 7

239-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
239-accept.text:
The Garrison on our western border sends word of increasing gnoll and thief activity.  They're requesting we send more Stormwind soldiers... but we just don't have any to spare!

If you can help, we could use it.  Go and speak with Deputy Rainer at the Westbrook Garrison and see what he needs done.

The Garrison is down the road to the west.  After you cross the bridge over the small brook it will be to the right.
239-accept.title: Westbrook Garrison Needs Help!

3094-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
3094-accept.text: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the $c trainer Gart. If this note is from Gart, I wouldn't take long in reading its contents.
3094-accept.title: Verdant Note

3094-complete.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-complete.text:
Though we share a common bond, do not expect much welcome from the night elves. Their pride still limits their sight, but that is none of our concern. The teachings of the Earthmother are all you must concern yourself with, and I will teach you what I know as you grow in wisdom.

Return to me often, $N. You will find that the Earthmother grants incredible abilities to those who are most dedicated.
3094-complete.title: Verdant Note

3094-progress.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-progress.text: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
3094-progress.title: Verdant Note

3102-complete.name: Jorik Kerridan
3102-complete.text:
You're gonna find a number of outfits that covet our skills, $N. Adventurers, SI:7... heck, even the Defias Brotherhood wouldn't mind a spy or two inside Stormwind. But you remember this, you're your own man. Don't let nobody bully you into doing something you don't wanna do! Besides, we hold all the cards... at least, we do before the game's done. Know what I mean?

Anyway, just wanted to introduce myself and let you know that I'm here if you need any training. Come by anytime.
3102-complete.title: Encrypted Letter

3102-progress.name: Jorik Kerridan
3102-progress.text:
You made it here in one piece, and it doesn't look like too many people saw you. Good enough for me. I don't like to have much attention drawn to me back here... nice and quiet. I'm sure you can understand.

Have any trouble yet? I'm glad to hear not. That'll change soon enough.
3102-progress.title: Encrypted Letter

3376-accept.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-accept.text:
$N - I have heard of you, newcomer.  Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We $r have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost.  The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us.  I charge you to bring me the chief's head!

He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
3376-accept.title: Break Sharptusk!

3376-complete.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-complete.text:
Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, $N.  Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.

You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young $c.
3376-complete.title: Break Sharptusk!

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

35-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
35-accept.text:
If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

Bring me his report.
35-accept.title: Further Concerns

35-complete.name: Guard Thomas
35-complete.text: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn.  We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
35-complete.title: Further Concerns

37-accept.name: Guard Thomas
37-accept.text:
A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned.  To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.

Travel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
37-accept.title: Find the Lost Guards

37-complete.name: Unknown
37-complete.text: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
37-complete.title: Find the Lost Guards

39-accept.name: Guard Thomas
39-accept.text:
Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.

I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
39-accept.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

39-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
39-complete.text:
Hmm, this news is troubling.  Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.

If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
39-complete.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

3903-accept.name: Deputy Willem
3903-accept.text:
You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903-accept.title: Milly Osworth

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

3904-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3904-complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904-complete.title: Milly's Harvest

3905-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3905-accept.text:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
3905-accept.title: Grape Manifest

3905-complete.name: Brother Neals
3905-complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!
3905-complete.title: Grape Manifest

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

40-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
40-accept.text:
$N, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest!  Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!

I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.

Please, $N, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
40-accept.title: A Fishy Peril

40-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
40-complete.text:
Yes, I spoke with Remy.  I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.

Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
40-complete.title: A Fishy Peril

45-accept.name: Unknown
45-accept.text:
Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

Perhaps Rolf's fate ended there...
45-accept.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

45-complete.name: Unknown
45-complete.text: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
45-complete.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

46-accept.name: Guard Thomas
46-accept.text:
The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn.  Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.

The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
46-accept.title: Bounty on Murlocs

469-accept.name: Einar Stonegrip
469-accept.text:
Greetings, traveler!

Don't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.

Now, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?

I'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.
469-accept.title: Daily Delivery

469-complete.name: James Halloran
469-complete.text:
Hmm, this is from Einar, right? Hasn't delivered his skins to me in person for almost a week now. No doubt it's some differences with the wife!

Maybe I'll have my wife go speak with Sida sometime...
469-complete.title: Daily Delivery

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

47-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-accept.text:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47-accept.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-complete.text: Thanks for the dust, $N.  Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine.  You might find it useful...useful.
47-complete.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

484-accept.name: James Halloran
484-accept.text:
I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.
484-accept.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

52-accept.name: Guard Thomas
52-accept.text:
Hail, $N.  Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears!

We could use your help out here.
52-accept.title: Protect the Frontier

52-complete.name: Guard Thomas
52-complete.text:
Thanks a lot for the help, $N.  Something in the forest must be making these animals so bold.

Whatever it is, I hope it stays there.
52-complete.title: Protect the Frontier

54-accept.name: Marshal McBride
54-accept.text:
$N, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54-accept.title: Report to Goldshire

54-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
54-complete.text:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54-complete.title: Report to Goldshire

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

5545-accept.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-accept.text:
I've got a real problem on my hands. I have a deadline looming for an order of lumber, and I'm running out of time. The wolves and bears north of here have chased my workers away from the bundles of wood that they've already chopped.

I've already talked to Deputy Rainer about clearing the animals, but I need someone to go collect the wood for me. If you could collect eight bundles of wood for me I might just make my deadline.
5545-accept.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-complete.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-complete.text:
Excellent! Thanks to you, I should be able to complete the order in time. To show my gratitude, I would like to offer some coin as compensation for your troubles.

Thank you and farewell.
5545-complete.title: A Bundle of Trouble

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

59-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
59-accept.text:
For your shrewdness and valor, I have a marker here that is good for one piece of armor.  I want you to take it to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.  Give her the marker, and she will fashion the armor for you.  And after you receive it, $N, use it in the defense of Elwynn.

The Eastvale Logging Camp is beyond Guard Thomas' post to the east.
59-accept.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

59-complete.name: Sara Timberlain
59-complete.text:
Ah, thank you for the marker.  Please feel free to pick your choice of armor.

Luck to you, brave $c.  And may this armor serve you well.
59-complete.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

59-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
59-progress.text:
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.

If you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
59-progress.title: Cloth and Leather Armor

6-accept.name: Deputy Willem
6-accept.text:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6-accept.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-complete.name: Deputy Willem
6-complete.text: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
6-complete.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-accept.name: William Pestle
60-accept.text:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
60-accept.title: Kobold Candles

60-complete.name: William Pestle
60-complete.text: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you?  Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
60-complete.title: Kobold Candles

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-accept.name: William Pestle
61-accept.text:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
61-accept.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

62-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
62-complete.text: This is bad news.  What's next, dragons?!?  We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine.  Thanks for your efforts, $N.  And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
62-complete.title: The Fargodeep Mine

71-accept.name: Unknown
71-accept.text: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
71-accept.title: Report to Thomas

71-complete.name: Guard Thomas
71-complete.text: You have confirmed my fears, $N.  The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
71-complete.title: Report to Thomas

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

743-accept.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-accept.text:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, $N. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
743-accept.title: Dangers of the Windfury

743-complete.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-complete.text: You have done well, $N. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
743-complete.title: Dangers of the Windfury

743-progress.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-progress.text: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
743-progress.title: Dangers of the Windfury

744-accept.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-accept.text:
$N, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
744-accept.title: Preparation for Ceremony

744-progress.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-progress.text: This headdress will certainly be a wonderful gift for my brother.
744-progress.title: Preparation for Ceremony

745-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-accept.text:
$N, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

Words are no longer the answer.
745-accept.title: Sharing the Land

745-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-complete.text: $N, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
745-complete.title: Sharing the Land

746-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-accept.text:
There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

You can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
746-accept.title: Dwarven Digging

747-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-accept.text:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. $R hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
747-accept.title: The Hunt Begins

747-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you, $N. You show much promise.
747-complete.title: The Hunt Begins

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

748-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-accept.text:
Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.

To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.

Return to me with the paws and talons, $N.
748-accept.title: Poison Water

748-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-complete.text: You have done well, $N. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
748-complete.title: Poison Water

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

749-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
749-accept.text:
A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.

We left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.

Perhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
749-accept.title: The Ravaged Caravan

749-complete.name: Unknown
749-complete.text: All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. Mining Division. Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.
749-complete.title: The Ravaged Caravan

750-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-accept.text:
A $r skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
750-accept.title: The Hunt Continues

750-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you for these provisions, $N. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
750-complete.title: The Hunt Continues

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

751-accept.name: Unknown
751-accept.text:
Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.

Up in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
751-accept.title: The Ravaged Caravan

751-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
751-complete.text: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.
751-complete.title: The Ravaged Caravan

751-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
751-progress.text:
Hail, $N. Have you learned anything new about the Venture Co.'s plans and operations in our homeland?

If they plan to exploit our lands as they have others, the Outrunners will be quick to put an end to it.
751-progress.title: The Ravaged Caravan

752-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
752-accept.text:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
752-accept.title: A Humble Task

752-complete.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
752-complete.text: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper? Here, take one of these training manuals with you, so you may learn how to contribute to the community.
752-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-accept.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
753-accept.text:
I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.

But you look like an eager $c. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.

Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
753-accept.title: A Humble Task

753-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-complete.text:
You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

Your willingness to help others and provide for the $r of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
753-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

754-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
754-accept.text:
I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!

This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.

Fortune to you, $N.
754-accept.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

754-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
754-complete.text:
News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.

You have done a great thing for the land, $N. And you have done a great thing for the $R people.
754-complete.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

755-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
755-accept.text:
Your willingness to perform a humble task for the $r of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, $N. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a $c of greatness.

Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
755-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

755-complete.name: Seer Graytongue
755-complete.text: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
755-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

756-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-accept.text:
To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
756-accept.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
756-complete.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

757-accept.name: Seer Graytongue
757-accept.text:
The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young $r needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.

First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.

Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.

Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
757-accept.title: Rite of Strength

757-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-complete.text: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.
757-complete.title: Rite of Strength

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

758-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-accept.text:
The totem is ready, $N. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
758-accept.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

76-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
76-accept.text:
Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds.  Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence.  To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora.  From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
76-accept.title: The Jasperlode Mine

76-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
76-complete.text:
Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say?  Curses!  The situation is worsening by the minute!

Thank you for the report, $N.  But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
76-complete.title: The Jasperlode Mine

761-accept.name: Harken Windtotem
761-accept.text:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
761-accept.title: Swoop Hunting

761-complete.name: Harken Windtotem
761-complete.text: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, $N.  In doing this, you prove that you are a $c of merit.  It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
761-complete.title: Swoop Hunting

761-progress.name: Harken Windtotem
761-progress.text: Have you found the swoops, $N.  Do you have their quills?
761-progress.title: Swoop Hunting

763-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
763-accept.text:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $N.

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
763-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-complete.text: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
763-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

766-accept.name: Maur Raincaller
766-accept.text:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

Hurry, time is of the essence.
766-accept.title: Mazzranache

766-complete.name: Maur Raincaller
766-complete.text:
Ah, thank you, $N. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

Be wary on your travels.
766-complete.title: Mazzranache

766-progress.name: Maur Raincaller
766-progress.text:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
766-progress.title: Mazzranache

767-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
767-accept.text:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
767-accept.title: Rite of Vision

767-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
767-complete.text: I sensed you would be coming to me, $c. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
767-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-accept.text:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
771-accept.title: Rite of Vision

771-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-complete.text: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, $N. It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
771-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-progress.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-progress.text: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
771-progress.title: Rite of Vision

772-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
772-accept.text:
I now present you with the Water of the Seers.

When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.

At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
772-accept.title: Rite of Vision

780-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-accept.text:
The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
780-accept.title: The Battleboars

780-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-complete.text: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
780-complete.title: The Battleboars

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

83-accept.name: Sara Timberlain
83-accept.text:
The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.

Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.

Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
83-accept.title: Red Linen Goods

83-complete.name: Sara Timberlain
83-complete.text:
Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...

Here you are!
83-complete.title: Red Linen Goods

83-progress.name: Sara Timberlain
83-progress.text: I'm running low on linen, $N.  Do you have any for me?
83-progress.title: Red Linen Goods

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?
91775-progress.title: Book Return

95805-progress.name: Unknown
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

96661-progress.name: Pyall Silentstride
96661-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96661-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97485-accept.name: Eylah Sunhorn
97485-accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485-accept.title: Traditions of the Bluff

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99143-progress.name: Lee Brown
99143-progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles
